title: Quests give Pollen rewards a claim button
summary:
Quests put Pollen rewards behind an explicit claim, while dashboard navigation and Gen docs got tidier.

A Quests dashboard now organizes rewards into Available, Claimable, and Claimed lanes, with a public catalog visitors can preview without signing in. Quests cover onboarding, model use, app growth, and contributions; a per-user check finds completed quests, and Pollen reaches the wallet when a reward is claimed. Public catalog and authenticated check-and-claim endpoints were added too. A follow-up corrected reward timestamps that could otherwise display as dates near 1970 or far in the future.

Dashboard sign-in redirects now preserve the current tab, including after GitHub sign-in. Signing out opens the signed-out News & FAQ tab.

The API docs gained icons and social-preview metadata, while the docs drawer now uses plain section names with separate icons across API and integration guides. Shared colors and a visible keyboard-focus style tidy up navigation.

highlights.title: Quests for Pollen
highlights.text: Browse quests, check which ones you’ve completed, and claim Pollen into your wallet. The dashboard keeps available, claimable, and claimed rewards in separate lanes.

highlights.title: Quest catalog and API
highlights.text: Read the public quest catalog or use session or API-key endpoints to check quests, list rewards, and claim them. The public `/quests/*` surface is available through Gen. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
